text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. Deep learning, a more advanced method, uses complex networks inspired by the human brain to handle huge amounts of information. You already use AI every day. When your phone suggests the next word in a message, when a streaming service recommends a movie, or when a navigation app finds the fastest route, AI is working behind the scenes. It is changing how we work, shop, and communicate, making many tasks faster and easier.
